$comment: Source of truth for the Cloudflare MCP portal mapping of server `tg` (mctlhq/.github#35). Every tool this server registers must appear here with an explicit decision; internal/mcp/portal_allowlist_test.go fails the build otherwise. An enabled tool must declare readOnlyHint=true AND carry a `reason` that says what the tool exposes and why that is acceptable on a shared surface: readOnlyHint is a side-effect hint, not a privacy classification, and several read-only tools return message bodies. Apply with scripts/portal-allowlist-apply.sh.

tools.name: get_my_identity
tools.reason: Returns the caller's own telegram_id, username and display name; nothing about other people or messages. It is the identity check the aggregate portal relies on.

tools.name: get_my_send_status
tools.reason: Returns booleans about the caller's own account (can_send, connected, consent); no message content, no peers.

tools.name: list_dialogs
tools.reason: Returns the caller's own dialog list (peer ids, titles, unread counts) and no message bodies. Chosen as the one catalogue-shaped read the pilot needs; get_messages/search_messages stay off because they return message text.
